sourceAuthority: src/Sollang.Compiler/CodeGen/LlvmEmitter.GenericDictionary.cs EmitInlineDictionaryTake allocates a replacement table at the same capacity, rehashes except the removed slot and frees the old table. This existing function was not changed.
derivation: Two arrays returned by make + initial heap dictionary table + replacement table during take = four allocations and four releases. Bounded dictionary uses inline storage and remains exactly two.
